title: Why did Monica Raymund leave Chicago Fire? The real reason behind Gabby Dawson's exit - NewsBreak
text:
By Abhishri Raman ,
1 hours ago During six seasons, Monica Raymund played the role of Gabriela “Gabby” Dawson, a crucial character of Chicago Fire’s Firehouse 51. Having started her journey as a leader of Ambulance 61, Gabby eventually became part of the firefighting team and thus an important figure in the plot of the long-running NBC series. But when Raymund left the series during its sixth season in 2018, the fans immediately began wondering about the reason for such a dramatic turn of events. Read full article
